description: This file defines a React functional component 'AgentFormFields' which renders a form with various configurable sections for an agent, incorporating shared configurations and styling from Ant Design components. It manages form fields for agent details, skills, capabilities, optional settings, cost configuration, and LiteLLM parameters.

methods.name: AgentFormFields
methods.description: React functional component that renders the agent form fields with optional agent name, collapsible panels for configuration sections, and dynamic skill list.
